notes: Red Bull replaces the MELBOURNE wordmark on the blue courtside floor panel. Across early/mid/late motion strips the logo is well-aligned and tracks the panel without visible jitter. Halo is the user-flagged failure mode and it is present here: a soft luminance halo around the bulls and the Red Bull lettering on the matte blue panel — clearly brighter at the immediate logo perimeter than the rest of the panel paint. The original MELBOURNE wordmark in the top row has no such glow, so I am scoring halo_presence 2 honestly rather than rounding up. Letter edges are otherwise reasonably crisp; reflex is mild (4). Late-frame strip (motion_strip_late) shows very small camera-motion drift but the logo stays glued to the panel; jitter score 4.
